notes: A backpack of 20+ miles with no single trailhead for 'west slope from Black Giant Pass'. Candidates: South Lake via Bishop Pass and Le Conte Canyon to the JMT and Muir Pass (USFS South Lake Trailhead 37.169305,-118.565813), Sabrina via Echo Col (the east variant the route text itself says adds class 3), or North Lake/Piute Pass.
